about.text: A local sheep-milk, smoked-cheese, handmade in the city of Taiz

sources.text: sheep or goat milk set with lamb/kid/calf rennet, rested in baskets then smoked 10-15 min; round flat 20 cm wheel; no ageing described

facts.v: The English article says milk is curdled in the evening with rennet from a suckling lamb, kid or calf, pressed the next day, and smoked for 10 to 15 minutes
About 20 cm across, 4 cm thick and about 1 kg
